component.name: CraftSpace
component.summary: Install and update the open-source ArtCraft creative apps

description.p: CraftSpace is an independent installer and update manager for the ArtCraft apps (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, VectorCraft, FilmCraft, GridCraft and more): one place to install them, keep them up to date and get to your files.

ul.li: Installs per user, or as system packages through dnf or apt
Checksum-verified downloads that resume, with update channels and rollback
Recent files, news, tutorials, fonts and a command line for scripts

screenshot.caption: All the ArtCraft apps in one place
